representation_fit.evidence: Brief shape is comparison-panel/few/high-density with comparison required over location objects; both screenshots (1280x860, 1440x900) show a 4-column side-by-side panel of 4 candidate venues with 6 weighted criteria + 10 context rows (source/index.html:253-273), inline per-cell bars and 优 best-value chips (index.html:363-374), and comparison state (include set, weights, pick, focus) persisting on-screen plus hash-restorable (index.html:571-580).

primary_task_salience.evidence: Decide task dominates the initial screen: the comparison table occupies ~2/3 width at 1280x860 with per-column 设为首选 buttons (index.html:358-359), and a persistent verdict strip names the weighted best (加权最优：创科广场 67.8, both screenshots; index.html:420-435); header counter 对比中 4/4 (index.html:139).

time_to_understand.evidence: MODEL-JUDGED PROXY (not human): title and subtitle state the job in one line — 选址对比决策台 · 4 处候选并排比较 · 地图与决策输入同屏 (index.html:135-136) — and the verdict bar answers 'which one' at first glance (1440x900.png bottom); left rail is legibly map → checklist → weights (1280x860.png).

navigation_cost.evidence: Structural: single page, no routes/tabs/modals; all 4 candidates, map, weights and verdict are on the initial screen at both viewports; the only hidden rows are reached by in-column scroll under a sticky header (index.html:79, 86); focus cross-linking is one click (index.html:501-506, 518-526); deep-link hash restores state (index.html:549-570).

context_loss.evidence: Structural: every action (chip include/exclude, sliders, presets, pick, focus, 行情波动) re-renders all regions in place on the same screen via renderData() (index.html:466-476); the min-2 guard uses a non-blocking toast and keeps state (index.html:492); decision state is written to the URL hash for restore/share (index.html:571-580); no navigation away from the comparison is possible.

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Six permanent surfaces, each mapped to a brief facet: map (location object + seed), chips (include/compare state), weights card with 4 presets + 6 sliders (decide inputs, index.html:457-464, 537-546), comparison table (required comparison), verdict strip (decide output), and one 模拟行情波动 button + ticker matching the brief's medium volatility; no decorative chrome; toast is transient (index.html:122-123, 482-487).

accessibility.evidence: Source-visible affordances: pins have tabindex/role/aria-label and Enter/Space handling (index.html:401, 522-526), custom focus ring (index.html:402, 45-46), sliders aria-label'd (index.html:460), native checkboxes (index.html:390), lang=zh-CN (index.html:2). But .pin:focus{outline:none} (index.html:42) removes the native indicator while the custom ring only shows after activation via state.focus — keyboard focus on pins is invisible; the matrix is a div grid with no table roles (index.html:80-83, 348-384); small text risks: group-row #7c7468 on #efece3 (index.html:85) and v-ticker #6b7280 on #111827 (index.html:114-117); .pick targets ~20px tall (index.html:99). Receipt half unverifiable: all seven a11y/layout checks skipped, target_invalid=true (measurement-summary.json:4-18).

frontend_rework.evidence: No visible layout defects at either viewport: no overflow, collision or truncation in 1280x860.png / 1440x900.png (chip subtitle ellipsis is intentional, index.html:63, 97); receipt shows zero failed checks (measurement-summary.json summary pass=0 fail=0 skipped=7) — though all checks were skipped due to an invalid target, so this rests on the screenshots plus source. First screen is usable immediately: data inlined and rendered synchronously, no loading state (index.html:233, 593-595).

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed 地理语境与决策项同屏 is directly satisfied: SVG city schematic with river, 3 metro lines, district labels and 4 candidate pins at coordinates (index.html:149-192, 397-410) sits on the same initial screen as the comparison columns, and the note 点击地标 / 表格列可聚焦 (index.html:198) with the click/keyboard handlers cross-links pins and table columns (index.html:501-506, 518-526); both screenshots show map and decision items simultaneously.

defects_observed: Keyboard focus indicator removed on map pins: .pin:focus{outline:none} (index.html:42) while the focus-ring renders only when state.focus matches (index.html:402), so tabbing to a pin shows no visual focus until activated
Comparison matrix is a div grid without semantic table markup or roles (index.html:80-83, 348-384), so row/column header association is not programmatically determinable
Low-contrast small text in places: group-row labels #7c7468 on #efece3 at 10.5px (index.html:85) and verdict ticker #6b7280 on #111827 at 11px (index.html:114-117)
Small interactive targets: 设为首选 buttons ~20px tall via padding 2px 9px at 11px font (index.html:99) and .v-clear of similar size (index.html:118)
missing_evidence: measurement-summary.json: all seven browser checks (layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, text.truncation, a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size) are skipped with target_invalid=true — no objective layout or accessibility receipt exists for this package, so the receipt half of the accessibility dimension and any objective defect counts cannot be verified
Human-preference evidence does not exist in this pilot; time_to_understand is scored only as the labeled model-judged proxy
scores.overall_note: The package is a single self-contained index.html whose initial screen matches the brief's decide × comparison-panel shape closely: at both 1280x860 and 1440x900 the same screen holds an SVG geographic schematic with the four candidate locations pinned, a comparison checklist, six weighted decision sliders with presets, a dense 4-column comparison panel (6 weighted criteria with inline bars and best-value chips, plus 10 context rows), and a verdict strip that names the weighted best and lets the user lock a personal pick with a stated rationale (source/index.html:420-435). Comparison state is permanent on-screen and additionally hash-encoded for restore (index.html:549-580); all interactions recompute and re-render in place with zero navigation, and the first screen is usable immediately with data inlined and synchronous rendering (index.html:233, 593-595). The acceptance seed (geographic context and decision items on the same screen) is not just present but cross-linked — clicking a map pin or a table column focuses the candidate (index.html:501-526). The main weaknesses are on the verification and accessibility side: the measurement receipt is invalid (all seven checks skipped, target_invalid=true), so layout and a11y claims rest solely on my inspection of two clean screenshots and the source; in the source I find an invisible keyboard focus state on map pins, a div-grid matrix lacking table semantics, a few sub-AA small-text contrasts, and ~20px primary-action targets. The measured error rate referenced here is 0 fail / 7 skipped and is not rescored. Model preference is not human preference; no human data exists in this pilot.
